reason: B offers the more physically credible strength–ductility strategy: a bimodal grain structure can combine fine-grain strength with coarse-grain strain accommodation and is directly testable against matched controls. Both proposals incorrectly treat the reported 13.5% terminal strain as uniform tensile elongation and imply that impact energy release was demonstrated for HfZrTiTa0.53 rather than WFeNiMo, but A additionally relies on a weak FCC-alloy analogy and an oversimplified fine-grain ductility mechanism.
